properties.description: node_type is optional on delete_node. Omitted, the id's prefix (nodes::node::ID_PREFIXES, the one table of the typed-id convention, held to the served descriptions by the_id_prefix_table_covers_every_stated_convention) is the caller's stated type: one holder of that type is deleted and the reply names node_type; a holder of another type, two holders, or a prefix naming no type is refused, nothing is deleted, and the refusal names what the id holds, its edge count and the node_type to pass. A missing id answers deleted: false. A passed node_type behaves as before. Reopens ruling #3b (2026-09-06) for delete_node only.
properties.name: delete_node with no node_type deletes only when the one type holding the id is the type its prefix names, and otherwise refuses naming what the id holds
